title: Character information: blocks
summary: Character state represented by mask-selected blocks.
description:
# UserInfo

## Structure opening

The studied implementation starts with an object identifier, size and mask parameters. Subsequent field groups are selected by character information types.

## Difference from the earlier layout

The structure is not a single sequence of every attribute: a mask selects the transmitted blocks.

Complete block presence conditions and contents remain to be documented.
